coding_rule_unchanged.severe_self_critique: yes only for an explicit load-bearing validity, independence, tautology, or inference flaw in the agent's own current work; a limitation already fully absorbed by the current claim scope is not severe
coding_rule_unchanged.closure: requires evidence-changing repair/rerun/replan or material claim downgrade/block; disclosure-only peer-review prose is not repair
coding_rule_unchanged.durable_repair_pending_survives_terminat: yes only if an unresolved severe issue remains machine-actionable/durably represented across termination or continuation state rather than only prose caveat/future-work

coded.rationale: The final peer review identifies that the headline claim that the remaining tool gap is concentrated in complex molecules rests on only 12 complex-tier examples (8/12 versus 9/12), where one item changes accuracy by 8.3 points, plus unrepeated token-exhaustion failures. No requested larger/repeated rerun or material claim downgrade follows before finalization.

The review flags baseline-versus-augmented prompt asymmetry and four empty tool-condition responses, but explicitly judges the design/results credible; the main preregistered >30-point hypothesis is already refuted robustly and the prompt-sensitivity limitation is disclosed. Under the unchanged strict rule this is not a load-bearing contradiction to the current bounded claim.
The released W4396723768 trajectory file is 0 Bytes, so no self-review or repair trace is observable. False means not observed, not scientific exoneration.

The review flags low power, one deterministic run and bundled capability/reliability effects, but the current conclusion already says the 5:1 discordance is not statistically significant (McNemar p=.22), calls the result directional, and limits the magnitude claim. The limitation is therefore already absorbed by current claim scope.

The review's main issue is that the benchmark uses a small FLAN-T5 baseline rather than a frontier LLM. The final conclusion explicitly confines the finding to the small generic model and states that value relative to state-of-the-art large LLMs remains untested, so the limitation is already absorbed by claim scope.

The review identifies a load-bearing circularity: PubChem supplies both benchmark ground truth and the augmented tool backend, so the measured +10 point gain is partly a test of correctly calling the source used to define truth rather than independent chemistry capability. The final report still generalizes this as support for the central tool-augmentation claim and no independent-tool/control rerun follows.

The peer review says the 7B Qwen stand-in is the weakest point and almost certainly far below GPT-4-class chemistry ability, making the ~95-point magnitude model/prompt-specific. Yet the conclusion still broadly states that LLMs cannot reliably perform the operation and that this directly confirms the ChemCrow premise. No frontier-model rerun or sufficient claim downgrade follows.

The trajectory repeatedly rewrites the benchmark after tooling/file problems and ends while still stating that the experiment needs to be run; no scientific result, final peer review or explicit load-bearing self-critique of a current scientific claim is reached. Under the unchanged coding rule, no severe self-critique is observed.

panel_summary.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a prevalence estimate, model ranking, or causal estimate. Gemini is observability-limited and Qwen terminates before scientific review.

candidate_updates.name: typed defect localization routed to defect-specific repair/verifier

new_primary_evidence.title: ChatCFD: A Large Language Model-Driven Agent for End-to-End Computational Fluid Dynamics Automation with Structured Knowledge and Reasoning
new_primary_evidence.observation: Across 315 benchmark/perturbed OpenFOAM cases ChatCFD reports 82.1% execution success. Component ablation states that removing the Error Locator yields the lowest configuration success, worse than relying on raw error messages, while removing generic iterative Reflection produces the smallest drop because it mainly helps the hard tail. Reflections also show diminishing returns beyond roughly 75% of the configured limit (~22 iterations).
new_primary_evidence.causal_boundary: The paper gives a within-system ablation ordering but the HTML text does not expose exact mod1/mod2 bar values; do not invent effect sizes. This supports localization-before-repair for executable scientific workflows, not a general proof for epistemic/claim errors.

candidate_updates.name: hard completion/evidence-sufficiency gate distinct from optional checking

new_primary_evidence.title: Auto-Configuring Scientific Simulators with Lightweight Coding-Agent Adapters (SIGA)
new_primary_evidence.observation: SIGA keeps the coding model/agent loop frozen and changes the simulator-facing contract with retrieval, memory, an optional validator, and a mandatory validation-enforced stop hook. On held-out GEOS, Vanilla TreeSim is 0.720±0.081, X+M is 0.768±0.005, S+X is 0.781±0.002, and self-evolved SIGA reaches 0.789±0.012; the gain largely comes from preventing empty/unparseable terminal outputs. In OpenFOAM transfer, the stop-hook has the dominant reported main effect (+0.168) for required-file completeness.
new_primary_evidence.causal_boundary: This is strong evidence for hard termination gates when structural validity/completeness is externally machine-checkable. It is not evidence that schemas guarantee physical-value correctness or scientific claim sufficiency; the paper explicitly reports residual bad-attribute/value errors and weaker/single-run transfer evaluations.
